data.name: Faatih
data.gender_notes: Faatih is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: One who opens or conquers. In Islamic history, Prophet Muhammad (pbuh) was given the title Al-Faatih (The Conqueror) due to his military victories. The name Faatih carries the meaning “Conqueror, Opener” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Faatih usually hope their child will grow to embody conqueror, opener and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes courage, determination, and victory in the journey of life.
data.etymology: Faatih belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Conqueror, Opener.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Faatih total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.
